provider: Indiana DNR/USGS 3DEP 2018 LiDAR; COPC mirror hosted by iDiF at Purdue
crop: Purdue GIS FID 794 polygon plus 12 m buffer; returned COPC points, classifications retained
transform: GIS EPSG:4326 footprint transformed with pyproj to EPSG:2968; z values retained in source vertical datum

statistics.method: Class 1 returns inside GIS ring eroded by 3 m; class 2 ground returns in a 5 m ring outside the GIS polygon. Height summary subtracts nearby ground median from class-1 percentiles. No class-6 building returns were present. Class 1 is unclassified and can include vegetation or other surfaces; this is a coarse roof/surface distribution, not measured eave or ridge elevation.

uncertainty: Point selection is map-boundary based; class 1 is not a roof-specific ASPRS class. Trees and wall returns may remain. Vertical datum/unit are read from tile CRS. The cloud is a 2018 condition and cannot verify current porch/roof changes.
